releaseNotes: feat: Add PC Mode screen with network management and pairing functionality
changelog: Implemented the PcModeScreen composable for managing PC mode, including starting/stopping the service, displaying connection status, and handling network information.
Added functionality for copying and sharing the PC mode URL, along with QR code generation.
Created ConnectedBrowserRow for displaying connected sessions and managing disconnections.
Introduced idle timeout settings with segmented button options.
Added security features including pairing code validation, IP address validation, and session management.
Developed unit tests for QR code generation, HTTP server behavior, and security mechanisms.
